profile.headline: Software Engineer | Rutgers, DAIICT
profile.summary: I am a software engineer, i.e I solve previously created tech debt with more advanced, fancier tech debt. Your next-cubicle query optimization & bug-hunting expert.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sustainability Engineering Team

 - Reduced stress on server storage drives by improving pdf generation code to reduce output file sizes by 90%.
 - Transformed a key reporting procedure in Oracle PL/SQL to speed up execution by 150x (from ~20 minutes to <8 seconds) by deep-diving into query plans, identifying performance bottlenecks, and applying suitable optimisation techniques along with strategic use of indexing, temporary tables, etc.
 - Carried out fixes on legacy visual basic applications running on old Windows 2008 servers to ensure smooth deployment over newer Windows 2019 and 2025 servers.
 - Worked in various web applications of the Aircraft Maintenance products, to address directly reported issues pertaining to data, application or UI/UX to ensure quick and reliable customer support, with considerations of pragmatism to deliver on SLAs & deadlines.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.locationName: New Brunswick, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description: Part-time lecturer and grader for CS 170: Computer Applications for Business.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Analyzed payment API structure to investigate payment frauds, integrated webhooks processing system along with revamped APIs to bring the fraud rate from monthly ~50 cases to a complete 0.
- Developed middleware microservices, allowing effortless integration of marketplace platforms with the in-house inventory and order management system to 2x the daily order volume.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented an event-driven asynchronous data transfer pipeline using Kafka and Logback feeding into a PostgreSQL database to deliver marketing analytics, scaling to daily 1M+ user actions.
- Set up views, indexes and cronjobs in the PostgreSQL database to simplify complex query scripts, reduced repetitive labor work performed by developers from weekly ~3 hours to ~30 minutes.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: - Collaborated to develop an end-to-end order and inventory management system using Java, Spring and MySQL to track items from stock purchase to order delivery, returns and exchanges.
positions.insights: Shell Scripting, Software Development and +12 skills

projects.title: Stream Processing with Apache Flink
projects.description: Used Docker to orchestrate a de-coupled data pipeline using Apache Kafka as a datastream source, and Apache Flink as a stream processor, to generate network usage limit alerts for a given user.

projects.title: H3 Dispatch Matching
projects.description: Developing a dispatch matching apparatus using Uber's opensource h3 geolocation indexing
